title: Discovery
description: What the API holds and which data release it is, as served at index.json.

dataVersion.description: The data release. A whole number from 1 that goes up with each release.

formulaVersion.description: The ratings formula these ratings follow. A whole number from 1 that goes up when the formula changes.

generateTime.description: When the pipeline wrote this release, as an RFC 3339 moment in UTC.

collections.description: Each collection the API holds, with its list file.

collectionId.description: The collection's id, the first part of its resource names, such as players.

uri.description: The collection's list file, as a path inside the API with no host.

schemaId.description: The $id of the schema the list file follows, such as players.schema.json.

itemCount.description: How many items the list file holds.
